messages:
Kai (PM): Quick sync: customer-Beta asked for per-tenant usage quotas + embedding isolation before pilot. We need to decide what goes into MVP vs what we push to v1. Short thread to lock scope.

Noor (Sales): Customer-Beta will sign a pilot NDA if we can promise quota controls (soft limits + alerts). They said hard isolation not required now, but quotas are table-stakes.

Leo (Eng): Quotas touch rate-limiting layer + billing events. Minimal impl: per-tenant soft quota with alerting + manual enforcement by ops. Hard enforcement and billing reconciliation are bigger (2-3 sprints).

Priya (Data): For monitoring, we'll need per-tenant token counters in the metrics pipeline. I can add tenant_id tags to counters in 1 sprint if the ingestion path is stable. Aggregation and retention for billing will be extra.

Jonas (Design): UI for quota notices is small: a banner + admin panel row. I can do mocks in 48h.

Mark (SRE): Ops impact: manual enforcement requires a documented runbook to disable tenants or throttle pools. That is doable today but risky without automation.

Kai (PM): Proposal: Ship MVP with soft per-tenant quotas (alerts + UI) + manual ops enforcement. Defer automatic hard throttling and billing integration to v1. This keeps sales happy and avoids introducing billing risk at GA.

Leo (Eng): Agree, but need to be explicit on rollback: feature flag the quotas and keep a fast kill switch. Also need a tiny migration plan for counters.

Priya (Data): I'll emit tenant-tagged token metrics under feature-flag; retention defaults to 30d. For v1 we can extend retention and export to billing.

Noor (Sales): I'll tell customer-Beta we can do "Soft Quotas + Pilot Support" in eu-central-1, with operational enforcement and weekly usage reports. They may ask for automation later.

Kai (PM): Checklist for MVP (shipline freeze):
```
- Soft per-tenant quotas (alerts + UI)
- Tenant-tagged token metrics (30d retention)
- Ops runbook for manual enforcement
- Feature flag + kill-switch
- Region: eu-central-1 pilot
- Defer: automatic throttling, billing export, per-tenant model pinning -> v1
```

Leo (Eng): Action items: I will add feature-flag wiring and a kill-switch. ETA 4 working days for flag+metrics hook.

Priya (Data): ETA 1 sprint to add tenant tags and dashboards. Will add a basic Grafana dash for the pilot.

Jonas (Design): Mocks in 2 days, small copy doc for support.

Mark (SRE): I'll write the ops runbook and test manual enforcement steps in staging. ETA 5 days.

Kai (PM): Noor, ping me when customer confirms pilot window. If they request hard enforcement, we surface the SOW for expedited billing integration.

Noor (Sales): Will do. Tentatively requesting pilot start +14 days.

rollout-bot: new-feature-flag created: tenant_quotas_preview (owner:Leo)

Leo (Eng): pushing feature-flag PR now.

Kai (PM): Good. Last note: we'll explicitly document what "Soft Quotas" mean in the pilot README so customer expectations are aligned. Jonas, please add copy.

Jonas (Design): On it.

Kai (PM): If no objections, we'll lock this as the scope for MVP. React if you agree.

Leo (Eng): :thumbsup:

Priya (Data): :thumbsup:

Mark (SRE): +1

Noor (Sales): :thumbsup: sending note to customer now.

Kai (PM): Thanks — closing thread when Noor confirms pilot date.
